what: The plan says to mirror the implementer mv stub, but that existing stub is an unconditional exit 99 and does not delegate unrelated mv calls.
scenario_or_breakage: Copying that shape into review-and-fix would fail harness or Cursor-fallback mv calls unrelated to the Codex auth-prep rename, creating false failures.
suggested_fix: Replace “mirroring” with an explicit conditional stub shape: fail only the larch-codex-review-fix-home.* config.toml rewrite/rename and exec /bin/mv "$@" for every other invocation.
